brief: A closed electronics enclosure with a louvred vent so the board inside can breathe.

requirements.evidence: Single hexagonal cell enclosed on top by cover:0,0,0;full;top and on all six side faces by caps cap:0,0,0;*;30/90/150/210/270/330 forming a sealed box; joints locked. Props PSU and multimeter staged to indicate electronics use.

requirements.requirement: Louvred vent so board inside can breathe
requirements.evidence: Port louvre installed at port:0#0,0#0 (slot 0) in the closed cell wall; part hex-port-louvre vents without letting rain in, providing airflow for internal board.

finish.summary: Built a closed single-cell hex enclosure (1 base + solid top cover + 6 solid end caps, joints locked) with a hex-port-louvre in one side wall to provide breathing while remaining rain-resistant; staged with PSU on top and multimeter beside to show electronics purpose. Verified clear with check_build.
